purpose: Pins the Stage 01 test files, which live under tests/stage01/ (outside the verification directory so the Stage 00 test plugin and CI collect them), by sha256 at the evidence revision, with the result of running each file.
environment: locked project environment (uv sync --locked): Python 3.12.3, pytest 9.1.1
check: for f in tests/stage01/*.py; do git show 85da719:$f | sha256sum; done
